note: The web smoke fails when the night's load (Play to a running night) divided by the same run's load to the menu is over max_ratio, or when the night alone is over ceiling_s (a backstop for a hang). Set from the 28 main runs of 2 and 3 Nov 2026 (the headless shell, SwiftShader, 1280x720): night 24.8 to 75.3 s, menu 8.6 to 17.5 s, ratio 2.23 to 4.56 (median 3.1); 5.5 is 20 % over the worst. The slowest run seen is 75.3 s, so 150 s is twice that. menu_floor_s (below every menu seen) keeps a lucky fast menu from inflating the ratio. Before this the gate was a flat 72 s (twice a 36 s mean of one morning, issue #509) and four runs tripped it with nothing wrong. Issue #873.
